recommendations.dietExerciseDrugs: Useful for patients with diabetes mellitus and extracranial carotid or vertebral artery atherosclerosis.
recommendations.note: The benefit of intensive glucose-lowering therapy to a glycosylated hemoglobin level less than 7.0% has not been established.

recommendations.statinTherapy: Administration of statin-type lipid-lowering medication to reduce LDL cholesterol to near or below 70 mg/dL is reasonable for patients with diabetes mellitus and atherosclerosis.

riskOfIschemicStrokeDiabetes.comparison: Increased 2- to 5-fold in patients with diabetes compared to those without.
factors: Elevated fasting and postchallenge glucose levels associated with stroke (292)
Diabetes associated with carotid IMT and arterial stenosis (24)
Diabetes and fasting glucose associated with carotid IMT (293-295)

insulinResistanceAtherosclerosisStudy.findings: Diabetes and fasting glucose associated with carotid IMT, which advanced more rapidly in patients with diabetes.

trials.name: ACCORD and ADVANCE
trials.findings: Intensive treatment did not reduce risk of stroke in patients with type 2 diabetes compared with conventional treatment.

trials.name: UKPDS
trials.finding: Intense treatment reduced rates of nonfatal MI and stroke.
